summary: A single six-operator FM synthesizer firmware meant for learning FM: every DX7-style parameter sits under a knob while you play, and the screen shows what each change did. No drums, patterns or song mode.
features: 8 voices of DX7-style FM: 32 algorithms, operator and pitch envelopes
Algorithm diagram, live spectrum and waveform screens; CPU meter
Eight operator waveforms, an extra global ADSR, and a filter
Chorus, phaser, delay and reverb; selectable sample rate and bit depth
20 factory voices and 256 user slots that take DX7 SysEx banks
MIDI in over USB and TRS; small arpeggiator and one-phrase looper

headings: ratio, and the two bytes under it
trying a change without the hardware
